name: local-asset-library
title: Local Asset Library
description: Browse, inspect, and copy local design assets from one library folder.
author: miguelcorderocollar

commands.name: colors
commands.title: Browse Colors
commands.description: Browse, inspect, and copy colors from the library folder colors.json file.

preferences.name: colorDefaultView
preferences.title: Default View
preferences.description: Choose whether colors open in grid view or list view by default.

preferences.name: colorGridColumns
preferences.title: Grid Size
preferences.description: Controls how many swatches appear per row in the Colors grid view.

commands.name: icons
commands.title: Browse Icons & Images
commands.description: Browse, preview, and copy local icons and images from the library folder.

preferences.name: assetGridColumns
preferences.title: Grid Size
preferences.description: Controls how many tiles appear per row in the Icons & Images grid view.

commands.name: fonts
commands.title: Browse Fonts
commands.description: Browse local font families, inspect metadata, and open font files.

preferences.name: assetRootFolder
preferences.title: Library Folder
preferences.description: Folder containing colors.json plus local icon, image, and font folders. Top-level folders become categories; nested folders become subcategories.
